description: This file contains utility functions for SQLAlchemy database interactions within the Superset project, including metadata retrieval, SQL parsing, and session object caching.

classes.name: SQLScript
classes.description: Class for parsing and analyzing SQL scripts, used to determine if the script contains mutations or multiple statements.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a database table, used in SQL parsing.

methods.name: get_physical_table_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a physical database table using SQLAlchemy inspector.

methods.name: get_virtual_table_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a virtual dataset by parsing its SQL query.

methods.name: get_columns_description
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to fetch column descriptions and data types.

methods.name: get_dialect_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the SQL dialect for a given driver.

methods.name: get_identifier_quoter
methods.description: Provides a quoting function for SQL identifiers based on the dialect.

methods.name: find_cached_objects_in_session
methods.description: Finds ORM instances in the current SQLAlchemy session cache by IDs or UUIDs.
